correctness.rationale: Reflection-fixed finite subsets of the unit circle consist uniquely of endpoint flags a,b in {0,1} plus j interior conjugate pairs, a+b+2j<=k. The closed ordered interior-point simplex gives each open CW cell E_ab^j; its j+1 alternating boundary faces are correct, including collisions and endpoint absorptions. Unit-coefficient algebraic pairs E10^(j-1)<->E00^j and E11^(j-1)<->E01^j yield a unique high-dimensional homology generator plus a connectedness base, with the predicted degree floor((k-1)/2). The explicit 3- and 4-stage loops and the degree-one 2-cell in Y5 kill pi1; subsequent new cells are >=2 dimensional, so Hurewicz and homological Whitehead upgrade to homotopy spheres. For odd k=2q+1, the new E00^(q+1) cell bounds a primitive old class; for even-to-odd, degrees differ, so every reduced persistence map is zero. Independently built exact cellular boundary matrices for all k<=16 satisfied boundary-square-zero and had the predicted integral-free ranks (rank calculations plus unit pivots); finite checks do not establish the all-k homotopy assertion.
